The idea

Perry photographs the people who keep Route 66 alive. Each writes an answer by hand.

The portraits

A touring exhibition and Perry's book.

The film

A short documentary of the journey.

The states

Eight short films, one for each state.

Why December

Route 66 turns 100 on November 11. By December the road belongs to the people who stay.

Road to
Freedom

All of Route 66 this December, Chicago to Santa Monica, and one question: what does freedom mean to you?
